<?php
$nom=$_POST["nom"];
$prenom=$_POST["prenom"];
$tel=$_POST["tel"];
$adr=$_POST["adr"];
$psw=$_POST["psw"];

mysql_connect("localhost","root","");
mysql_select_db("rafehmaddouripizza2020");
$req1="select * from client where (nom<>'$nom' or prenom<>'$prenom') and tel='$tel'";
$res1=mysql_query($req1);
if (mysql_num_rows($res1)!=0) {
	echo "Erreur : Tél, Nom ou Prénom erroné";
	
}
else{
	$req2="select * from client where nom='$nom' and prenom='$prenom' and tel='$tel'";
	$res2=mysql_query($req2);
	if (mysql_num_rows($res2)!=0) {
		echo "client deja existe";
	}
	else{
		$req3="insert into client values('$tel','$nom','$prenom','$adr','$psw')";
		$res3=mysql_query($req3);
		if (mysql_affected_rows()!=-1) {
			echo "client ajoutee avec success";
		}
	}

}




?>
